g.title: MarieRank1Convo1 begins.
g.text: MarieRank1Convo1 begins.

g.title: j752199551
g.text: Bonjour, bonjour, Drifter ! How are you this fine day ? Or evening. I truly do not know what time it is in this place.

g.title: j3217424172
g.text: I am certain one of these bibelots that Monsieur Loid keeps is a clock, but I cannot for the life of me determine which it is.

g.title: j575823267
g.text: I fear to touch any device in this strange sanctum. I fully believe I am just as liable to send myself careening into some far-flung distant time as I am to warm a cup of tea.

g.title: j3066524994
g.text: It's probably best not to press any buttons you aren't certain about, no.

g.title: j3434089426
g.text: I'm sure you'll be fine.

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j3393766703
g.text: Very good advice, indeed. I have heard from Monsieur Loid that you had your own aventure temporelle. I wonder -

g.title: j1276117372
g.text: C'est très gentil de votre part, but... you are not the one who has been thrown into another... ah. Right. Yes !

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j2152956983
g.text: Was it as dangerous as this one ?

g.title: j680433469
g.text: You would know, wouldn't you. Forgive me. Was your own personal adventure as dangerous as this one ?

g.title: j2774070407
g.text: The time period? Or my stay there in particular?

g.title: j2419756360
g.text: It was different, but I promise you're safe here.

g.title: j111867590
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j1930843019
g.text: I very much appreciate your rousing vote of confidence, but I do not precisely share it. Especially not when I have such trouble simply discerning the time.

g.title: j982070711
g.text: Good to make the distinction. I hardly doubt your experience with the past was "normal" by aggregate standards. I certainly hope not, by the tell of it.

g.title: j3724771084
g.text: One would expect there to be one in the corner of this... "screen" here, but there is not ! Mauvaise qualité, if you ask me.

g.title: j2709872566
g.text: I meant the "time period" itself. Allow me to rephrase -

g.title: j3575712883
g.text: Regardless, we have wandered quite far from my question !

g.title: j4164538332
g.text: Was this "past" era that you traveled to, that is indeed far closer to the "farther past" from which I hail, more or less latently dangerous than this time in which we currently find ourselves ?

g.title: j3990349436
g.text: (Goodness ! I do love this, I must say it is far more interesting than dusting communionware.)

g.title: j1383128467
g.text: I think it's about the same. The weaponry is different and they might not know what they're up against yet, but war is war and death is death.

g.title: j3591531957
g.text: I think this time is less dangerous. We have more ability to deal with the challenges we're facing. They're just getting started.

g.title: j3300737671
g.text: I think this time is more dangerous. While we still have the Infested in common, they were dealing with far more rudimentary weaponry.

g.title: j4268863721
g.text: Honestly, I'm just glad you're enjoying yourself. It can be a lot to adapt to all at once.

g.title: j3355359851
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2328179725
g.text: You may be right. I will think on it. Thank you.

g.title: j1105747329
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3411516675
g.text: Like all things, I suppose it would be relative, non ? The predator that kills us now is just as deadly as that which hunted us then. It just sharpens its teeth.

g.title: j2321280444
g.text: I was prepared for this by le Cardinal Dimanche - your Albrecht Entrati. Unlike my dear Lyon, I believed his words as fact. And unlike Lyon, I see this as our great adventure, not a burden.

g.title: j4059778359
g.text: Unless you're Orokin, who found a way to avoid death... in theory, if not in practice.

g.title: j1103471228
g.text: I'm also happy that you're adapting well to the future.

g.title: j1485292009
g.text: Service to the Luminaries needn't be an act of suffering. In this, we have always differed.

g.title: j3182581997
g.text: And I believe the devil is a perfect example of why death is the greatest gift that Lua has ever given us.

g.title: j2002399423
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j4240921033
g.text: Boolean MarieLyonSuffering1 is now true.

g.title: j3039520953
g.text: Boolean MarieRoathe1 is now true.

g.title: j2351416248
g.text: I was prepared for this by le Cardinal Dimanche - your Albrecht Entrati. Unlike my dear Lyon, I believed his words as fact. And unlike Lyon, I see this as our great adventure, not a burden.

g.title: j3678852566
g.text: And do not avoid my question, silly ! Which do you think is more dangerous ?

g.title: j1395510218
g.text: Oh ! Now that is the sound of a clock I do recognize, though I still cannot identify where the blasted thing is located. Either way, I fear I must go. This has been delightful. Until we can "meet" again ! Aux Dieux !

g.title: j511324148
g.text: Service to the Luminaries needn't be an act of suffering. In this, we have always differed.

g.title: j1400904662
g.text: I believe this time is more deadly. We have how many impossible enemies trying to kill us?

g.title: j2494294621
g.text: I believe our time is less dangerous. They are just discovering new ways of killing each other. Our ways are just a bit more exciting in looks, perhaps.

g.title: j612630645
g.text: I believe it is probably about equal, in the end. Death is death, isn't it?

g.title: j3692086785
g.text: Boolean MarieLyonSuffering1 is now true.

g.title: j2886084869
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3582703831
g.text: Like all things, I suppose it would be relative, no ? The predator that kills us now is just as deadly as that which hunted us then. It just sharpens its teeth.

g.title: j1325461329
g.text: As someone who tries to defend against the wolf, I often find myself exhausted by this.

g.title: j4093782669
g.text: I think you, my dear Drifter, are more likely to run off to join the pack of wolves than to sit guard against it. And I do mean that as a compliment.
